## 1. Result and prepared reuse

For the retained exponential-affine w=exp(-Vhat+gauge), let v be the
unchanged nonnegative, zero-boundary Q1 field and j the unchanged RT0 field
with exact -div j=u>=w. Define

\[
 L=\int vw,\quad E=\int w|\nabla v|^2,\quad V=\int v^2w,
 \quad R=\int |j|^2/w,\quad Q=\int u^2/w,
 \quad U=\int u,\quad M=\int w.
\]

| Quantity | Used value or enclosure |
|---|---:|
| L, lower | 10,339,980.413984356 |
| E, upper | 8,760,250.249974636 |
| R, upper | 13,453,868.116228491 |
| V | [88,290,158,078,810.3, 88,290,158,078,818.47] |
| Q | [1.330658107800660, 1.3306581078007016] |
| U, display of exact rational | 1.2686452492209614 |
| M | [1.2109525849615819, 1.210952584961618] |

The JSON stores exact Fractions. Upstream Delta and kappa remain
487306526401191/7812500000000000 and
100000080190000793881/99999982180000793881. Let e2 be the exact rational
upper enclosure of exp(2 Delta). Prepare

\[
 A=\frac{L_{lo}^2}{e2 M_{hi}},\quad
 B=\frac{\kappa e2 R_{hi}Q_{hi}}{M_{lo}},\quad C=\kappa R_{hi}.
\]

The lower and basic upper curves are

\[
 \ell(s)=\frac{A}{E_{hi}+sV_{hi}},\qquad
 r(s)=\frac{B}{Q_{hi}+sC}.
\]

For positive s, the released upper is the minimum of r(s), 1/s, and

\[
 h(s)=\frac{e2}{s}
       \left(1-\frac{U^2}{M_{hi}(Q_{hi}+sC)}\right).
\]

At zero use r(0). Every new rate costs a fixed number of scalar rational
operations; numerical output must retain outward evaluation. Illustrations:

| Rate s | Lower response | Upper response | Endpoint factor |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 8,896,462.2430 | 12,586,323.6224 | 1.4147561 |
| 9.92211413e-8 | 4,448,231.1215 | 5,724,628.7629 | 1.2869450 |
| 4.03938179e-7 | 1,754,349.1717 | 2,253,571.4041 | 1.2845627 |
| 9.92211413e-6 | 88,083.7846 | 100,784.9725 | 1.1441944 |
| 1 | 0.8827170497 | 1 | 1.1328659 |

The examples are not the continuum proof. At zero, scalar optimization
of the old potential improves its previous unscaled lower witness from
8,688,806.6039 to 8,896,462.2430. The field was not re-solved. The main
addition is the entire response family, not this endpoint improvement.

\]
